{"test_name":"LedgerIssue2283","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class LedgerIssue2283\n{\n    private const string LibSource = \"\"\"\n        using MessagePack;\n\n        namespace Lib;\n\n        [MessagePackObject]\n        public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n        \"\"\";\n\n    private const string AppSource = \"\"\"\n        using MessagePack;\n        using Lib;\n\n        namespace App;\n\n        [MessagePackObject]\n        public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n        {\n            [Key(1)]\n            public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n        }\n        \"\"\";\n\n    private static async Task<CSharpCompilation> CreateAppCompilationAsync()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> baseReferences = net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(LibSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver libDriver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        libDriver = libDriver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(libCompilation, out Compilation libOutputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> libGenDiagnostics);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(libGenDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        using MemoryStream libStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult libEmitResult = libOutputCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        Assert.True(libEmitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, libEmitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(libStream.ToArray());\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> appReferences = baseReferences.Append(libReference);\n\n        return CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(AppSource, parseOptions) },\n            appReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratorSucceedsOnClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly()\n    {\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = await CreateAppCompilationAsync();\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        foreach (GeneratorRunResult result in runResult.Results)\n        {\n            Assert.Null(result.Exception);\n        }\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> compilationErrors = outputCompilation\n            .GetDiagnostics()\n            .Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)\n            .ToImmutableArray();\n        Assert.Empty(compilationErrors);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task AnalyzerDoesNotCrashOnClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly()\n    {\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = await CreateAppCompilationAsync();\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n    }\n}\n"}
